mapper.select: SELECT ID, TASK_NAME, TASK_CLASS, ENABLED, INTERVAL_MINUTES, CRON_EXPR, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM SWZZ_TASK_CONFIG ORDER BY CREATE_TIME
SELECT ID, TASK_NAME, TASK_CLASS, ENABLED, INTERVAL_MINUTES, CRON_EXPR, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM SWZZ_TASK_CONFIG WHERE ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME
mapper.update: UPDATE SWZZ_TASK_CONFIG SET ENABLED = #{enabled}, UPDATE_TIME = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE SWZZ_TASK_CONFIG SET INTERVAL_MINUTES = #{intervalMinutes}, UPDATE_TIME = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO SWZZ_TASK_CONFIG T USING ( SELECT #{id} AS ID, #{taskName} AS TASK_NAME, #{taskClass} AS TASK_CLASS, #{enabled} AS ENABLED, #{intervalMinutes} AS INTERVAL_MINUTES, #{cronExpr} AS CRON_EXPR, #{remark} AS REMARK FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.ID = S.ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.TASK_NAME = S.TASK_NAME, T.TASK_CLASS = S.TASK_CLASS, T.ENABLED = S.ENABLED, T.INTERVAL_MINUTES = S.INTERVAL_MINUTES, T.CRON_EXPR = S.CRON_EXPR, T.REMARK = S.REMARK, T.UPDATE_TIME = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID, TASK_NAME, TASK_CLASS, ENABLED, INTERVAL_MINUTES, CRON_EXPR, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskName}, #{taskClass}, #{enabled}, #{intervalMinutes}, #{cronExpr}, #{remark}, TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss'), TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss'))
